description: Register a TwitterAdsResource (OAuth 1.0a) for the X (Twitter) Ads API for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

consumer_key_env_var.label: Consumer Key Env Var
consumer_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the X Ads API Consumer Key (API Key)

consumer_secret_env_var.label: Consumer Secret Env Var
consumer_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding the X Ads API Consumer Secret (API Secret)

access_token_env_var.label: Access Token Env Var
access_token_env_var.description: Env var holding the X Ads API Access Token

access_token_secret_env_var.label: Access Token Secret Env Var
access_token_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding the X Ads API Access Token Secret

account_id.label: Account ID
account_id.description: X Ads Account ID (not the numeric X/Twitter user ID)

api_base_url.label: API Base URL
api_base_url.description: X Ads API base URL (override for a different API version).

name: Twitter/X Ads Resource
